payload.text: hv, 2026-11-04, in vc's session: 'you have the pen here with pplr and cldr... I want both properly finished this morning', then ccusage-vc and ccusage-dc added: 'I want all three of these rust cli utils to operate in the same way (ie signed and notarised, and be able to be built from a single devbin command)'. vc drives pplr-dc, cldr-vc, cldr-dc, ccusage-vc and ccusage-dc. The shape, decision 27's, for all three: bin/devbin release vX.Y.Z is the whole release, project.version_from: Cargo.toml with derived: bin/devbin lock-sync, a CHANGELOG section the cut dates, and one after: line, bin/devbin post-cut, that signs and notarises with the neutral credentials geodica.apple.*, attaches, publishes the formula and pulls the tap, stopping at the first failure. ccusage keeps CI's four archives, so its post-cut runs macos finalize on CI's draft. pplr's todo 6 becomes ST0003, released as 2.0.1. Cuts, tags and pushes stay hv's.
